mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the triceps was most worthwhile because it showed why the arm needs opposing muscles: each can pull, but neither can push the bone back.

leastWorthwhile.text: Grouping the fibres was straightforward and did not add much explanation by itself, although it set up the later construction.

surprise.text: Adding sheaths to the bundle produced a complete biceps with tendons in one step. The explanation helped connect the tissue to the muscle’s pull.

arbitrary.text: The rapid jump from one fibre bundle to a complete biceps felt a little abrupt, even though the connective tissue’s role was explained.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the unfinished vessel ends connect the arm to the larger circulation and support its working cells.
